Container.Name: Mocha
Container.Overview: Media server for comics, manga, and BDs with built-in acquisition, metadata plugins, and tracker scrobbling.
Container.Description:
Mocha is a Komga fork that adds native acquisition workflows, multi-source metadata matching, and two-way read-progress sync with your trackers — no sidecars needed.
[b]Key features:[/b] [ul] [li]Mihon/Tachiyomi APK extension runtime — download chapters from 2,000+ sources via real APK extensions[/li] [li]Wanted List — search across sources, track WANTED → ACQUIRING → ACQUIRED, with library scan integration[/li] [li]Multi-tracker import — bulk-import reading lists from AniList, MAL, Kitsu, and MangaUpdates[/li] [li]Auto-match — one-click metadata matching against AniList, MangaDex, ComicVine, Metron, MAL, Kitsu, MangaUpdates[/li] [li]Two-way scrobbling — push read progress to AniList, MAL, Kitsu, MangaUpdates, Metron; pull back via Provider Sync[/li] [li]ComicVine + Metron support for western comic metadata[/li] [li]GetComics acquisition for western comics[/li] [/ul]
[b]Setup:[/b] Mount your comic/manga library directories, set the WebUI port (default 25600), configure PUID/PGID to match your library permissions, and start the container. The first-run wizard guides you through library creation and plugin configuration. See the README for a full setup walkthrough and metadata provider/extension setup guide.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Mocha web UI

Config.Name: Library Root
Config.Description: Parent directory holding all your library folders (e.g. comics, manga, ecchi, books). Create subfolders here and add each as a library in Settings — adding a new library never needs another mount.

Config.Name: Config Dir Override
Config.Description: Mocha config directory (advanced — should match the Config Directory path above)

Config.Name: Scan Exclusions
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of directory names to exclude from library scans

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run Mocha as — must have read/write access to library paths

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run Mocha as

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Umask for files created by Mocha (e.g. downloaded chapters, CBZ files)
